instrument_name: Alabama Withholding Tax Tables and Instructions for Employers and Withholding Agents, revised January 2026 (whbooklet_0126) - formula, standard deduction schedule, exemptions, returns
authority: Alabama Department of Revenue, Withholding Tax Section
article_or_section: pp.1-7 (formula p.6, standard deduction schedule p.7)
figure_or_rule_carried: Formula: annualise gross; deduct (A) standard deduction - 0/S: 3,000 if GI<=25,999, minus 25 per 500 above 25,999, 2,500 if GI>=35,500; MS: 4,250 / minus 88 per 250 above 12,999 / 2,500 at 17,750; M: 8,500 / minus 175 per 500 / 5,000 at 35,500; H: 5,200 / minus 135 per 500 / 2,500 at 35,500; (B) annualised federal income tax withheld; (C) personal exemption 0 / 1,500 S or MS / 3,000 M or H; (D) dependents 1,000 (GI<=50,000), 500 (<=100,000), 300 (>100,000); rates 0/S/H/MS 2% first 500, 4% next 2,500, 5% over 3,000; M 2% first 1,000, 4% next 5,000, 5% over 6,000; divide by periods; formula result may be rounded to nearest dollar, tables to nearest dollar; supplemental 5% allowed; A-4 required (W-4 not accepted), none filed = zero exemptions; A-4 retained 3 years; worked example M-2 weekly 850, fed 35.19 -> annual tax 1,538.50 -> 29.59 per week (re-derived in Python). A-6 monthly if >1,000 withheld in month 1 or 2 of quarter, due 15th; A-1 quarterly due last day of following month; A-3 + W-2s due 31 January; e-file mandatory for any single payment >=750 and for 10+ W-2s; penalties 10% or 50 USD; exempt classes follow federal (domestic, ministers, agricultural - AL does not follow federal withholding on agricultural cash wages); exclusions IRC 125, 219, 401(k), 403(b), 408(k), 408(p), 457; severance exemption up to 50,000 with ADOR approval

instrument_name: ADOR Withholding Tax page (forms list: A-6, A-1, A-3, Form 10, A4, A4-MS, 2848A)
figure_or_rule_carried: Lists A-6 monthly, A-1 quarterly, A-3 annual reconciliation (2026/03 editions), Form 10 e-file spec rev. 08/2024, Form A4 (link A4_0425; page text still says Revised March 2014 - the PDF itself prints REV. 4/2025), Spanish Forma A4, A4-MS, BF-1 bulk filer, 2848A POA; menu shows Overtime Premium Deduction (Act 2026-604) and Portable Benefit Accounts

instrument_name: ADOR 30-Day Safe Harbor Rule page (Act 2025-334)
figure_or_rule_carried: Nonresident performing duties in AL 30 or fewer days in calendar year, duties in more than one state, home state has similar exclusion or no income tax: no AL withholding or filing; 31+ days: all AL income for the year taxable and withheld/reported to AL; excludes professional athletes, entertainers, public figures; qualifying states as of 2026-10-01: AK, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MT, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WV, WY; time-and-attendance record recommended; penalty discretion when threshold exceeded. Re-read of US-MULTI-021.

instrument_name: ADOR Overtime Premium Deduction (Act 2026-604) page
figure_or_rule_carried: Calendar years 2026-2028: deduction on the AL individual return of the lesser of the overtime premium (portion above base rate) or 1,000 USD per taxpayer; operating level = ASSESSMENT (W-2 box 12 TT information does not change wages, withholdings or taxes); total overtime wages stay in W-2 box 16; replaces the earlier overtime exemptions of Act 2023-421 and Act 2024-437 (linked as previous)

instrument_name: Form A4 Employee Withholding Tax Exemption Certificate (REV. 4/2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: Lines: 1 zero; 2 S or MS (1,500); 3 M or H (3,000); 4 number of dependents; 5 additional amount per period; 6 employer total (e.g. M-2 column); furnish on or before commencement; penalty 500 USD for inflated exemptions (Ala. Code 40-29-75); employer contacts ADOR if 8+ dependents or excess claimed, withholds at highest rate until corrected A4; Spanish edition A4_0425_sp exists

instrument_name: ADOR Form 10 Specifications for filing Wage and Tax Information electronically (8/24)
figure_or_rule_carried: E-file mandatory for 10+ wage statements or if filed/paid electronically; SSA EFW2 format with modifications; ADOR reads only the RS record, 512 bytes, no delimiters; RS fields: AL withholding account no. cols 248-257, FEIN 258-266, state code 274-275 (AL or 01), state taxable wages 276-286, state tax withheld 287-297, FEDERAL income tax withheld 298-307, other income 338-348, payment year 393-396; count of statements must match A-3; upload via My Alabama Taxes

instrument_name: Workforce Alabama Employer FAQ (UC liability, new account rate, rate range, quarterly report, wage base, other-state wages, cafeteria plans)
authority: Alabama Department of Workforce, Unemployment Compensation
article_or_section: FAQ (Employer Registration & Taxes; Tax Rates; Quarterly Reports & Wages)
figure_or_rule_carried: Liability: 1+ worker in 20 weeks or 1,500 USD wages in a quarter; household 1,000 USD cash wages in a quarter; agricultural 10+ workers in 20 weeks or 20,000 USD in a quarter; churches and church-controlled organisations not covered; 501(c)(3) liable with 4+ workers in 20 weeks. New account rate 2.70% on first 8,000 USD per employee per calendar year. Experience rates incl. 0.06% ESA range 0.20%-6.80% across schedules A-D, plus shared cost; all rates reduced by 0.06% ESA except 5.40%. Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report online only (eGov), due last day of month after quarter (31 Jan, 30 Apr, 31 Jul, 31 Oct); late penalty greater of 25 USD or 10%; interest 1% per month. Wages paid by an AL employer for employment in another state count toward the 8,000. Cafeteria-plan reductions are reportable for UC if the employee has a cash option. Corrections via UC-10-C.

instrument_name: Workforce Alabama New Hires page
authority: Alabama Department of Workforce, New-Hire Unit
figure_or_rule_carried: Report each newly hired or recalled employee within 7 days of hire or re-employment (rehire = separated 60+ consecutive days); electronic filers may transmit twice monthly 12-16 days apart; fine up to 25 USD per violation; employers with 5+ employees must report electronically (since 2008-05-01); upload fixed-length or CSV/tab-delimited file or online form; W-4 copies by mail/fax accepted; NH-1 card no longer accepted; independent contractors not reported; multistate employer may designate one state by notifying HHS; system also takes job-refusal reports

instrument_name: Code of Alabama 1975 Sec. 25-4-16 (wages, 8,000 USD taxable base, other-state employment counted) and Sec. 25-4-54 (experience-rated contributions, shared cost)
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wages exclude remuneration above 8,000 USD paid in a calendar year by an employer (or predecessor); employment includes service under another state UI law (so wages reported to another state count toward the AL base); exclusions for employer retirement, sickness, medical, death plans. 25-4-54: rate set yearly from benefit ratio and fund balance as of 30 June; shared cost defined and added. Base not indexed (fixed in statute unless federal base exceeds it).

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 25-7-41 (Act 2016-18): local governments barred from wage, leave, benefit or schedule mandates
figure_or_rule_carried: No county, municipality or political subdivision may require an employer to provide any employment benefit (paid or unpaid leave, vacation, wage, work schedule) not required by state or federal law; inconsistent local mandates void; exception for public employees (25-7-43). Consequence: no local minimum wage and no local paid-sick-leave ordinance can bind private AL employers.

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 40-18-71 (withholding tax) and 40-18-74 (payment of amounts withheld)
figure_or_rule_carried: Withhold on wages reduced by the optional standard deduction (40-18-15(b)) and FEDERAL income tax withheld, 2% first 500, 4% next 2,500, 5% over 3,000, above exemptions of 40-18-19 claimed on the certificate; employer credits against withholding the job development fee of 41-10-44.7(b) (Jobs Act incentive); tables optional and substantially equivalent; wages may be computed to the nearest dollar; additional voluntary withholding allowed. 40-18-74: quarterly return due last day of month after quarter; monthly return and payment by the 15th when the first or second month withholding exceeds 1,000 USD.

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 12-16-8 and 12-16-8.1 (jury duty) and 17-1-5 (time off to vote)
figure_or_rule_carried: Jury duty: employee excused; may not be required to use annual, vacation, unpaid or sick leave; any FULL-TIME employee is entitled to his or her usual compensation (paid jury leave, no cap stated); no discharge or adverse action for jury service. Voting: necessary time off up to 1 hour on reasonable notice, not available if shift starts 2+ hours after polls open or ends 1+ hour before polls close; statute silent on pay.

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 6-10-7 (wage garnishment exemption) and 30-3-61, 30-3-67, 30-3-70 (child-support income withholding)
figure_or_rule_carried: 6-10-7: wages of AL residents 75% exempt from garnishment for consumer debts and tort judgments, garnishee retains 25% (statute base = wages due, apply together with CCPA 15 U.S.C. 1673 disposable-earnings limit, the more protective governs); report termination to the court within 15 days and pay in sums withheld; begin paying into court 30 days after first retention, then monthly or more often. Child support: employer pays to the court clerk or DHR designee within 7 business days of payday; out-of-state IWO follows the law of the obligor's principal place of employment for fee, maximum and timing; IWO has priority over garnishments and may exceed 6-10-7 up to the federal CCPA support limits; current support before arrears; no discharge or refusal to hire because of an IWO (contempt).

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 25-8-33 and 25-8-35 (child labour: minimum age, prohibited occupations)
figure_or_rule_carried: No individual under 16 employed except in agricultural service and as the chapter allows; 14-15 year olds may work outside school hours and in vacations, not in manufacturing/mechanical establishments; list of prohibited occupations for under-16s; no state minor minimum wage (federal applies).

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 25-1-30 Clarke-Figures Equal Pay Act (Act 2019-519)
figure_or_rule_carried: No pay differential by sex or race for equal work in the same establishment except seniority, merit, production-based systems or other factor; employer may not refuse to interview, hire or promote an applicant for declining to give wage history

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 8-38-2 Alabama Data Breach Notification Act of 2018 (Act 2018-396)
figure_or_rule_carried: Breach = unauthorised acquisition of electronic data containing sensitive personally identifying information (SSN, etc.); covered entities must protect and notify under ch. 8-38; no pay-statement SSN truncation statute located (only definitions section read; notice timing sections not read)

instrument_name: City of Leeds Employer's Withholding Guide for Occupational Tax
authority: City of Leeds, Alabama (revenue examiner; remittance via Avenu)
figure_or_rule_carried: Exemplar of an AL municipal occupational tax: employer must withhold the City Occupational Tax, 1% of each employee's gross earnings for work in the city (example 3,000 x 1% = 30); business licence required first; monthly return and remittance to the Avenu Tax Remittance Department; annual reconciliation with a summary of the year's withholdings; employer informs employees, e.g. by showing the amount on the pay stub; records kept at least 5 years. Guide undated (edition not printed)

instrument_name: City of Birmingham Finance Department, Tax and License Division page
authority: City of Birmingham, Finance Department, Tax and License Administration
figure_or_rule_carried: Occupational Tax is one of the city taxes filed and paid online through the HdL portal (birminghamal.hdlgov.com), the city's preferred channel; contact 205-254-2198, BhamTLSupport@birminghamal.gov. Rate (1% per Code Title 3 Ch. 2, US-ALP7-001, MANUAL) and return frequency NOT stated on this page

instrument_name: ADOR news: Additional Relief for Taxpayers Affected by Hurricane Isaias (2026-10-15)
figure_or_rule_carried: Individual income tax returns due 2026-10-15 in designated disaster areas extended to 2027-02-04; other filings (incl. withholding) relief only case by case on request (Withholding Tax 334-353-7680). No automatic extension of A-1/A-6/A-3 deadlines

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 40-18-15.6 (health savings account contributions)
figure_or_rule_carried: Residents may deduct HSA contributions made on or after 2018-01-01 up to the IRC 223 maximum; employer contributions are not includible in the employee's income (AL conforms to the federal HSA exclusion, unlike CA/NJ)

instrument_name: Code of Alabama Sec. 25-1-70 to 25-1-72 Portable Benefits Act (effective 2025-12-31)
figure_or_rule_carried: Hiring parties may contribute to portable benefit accounts of independent contractors; contribution is not evidence of an employment relationship; for tax years after 2025-12-31 the hiring party deducts 100% of contributions and the qualifying independent contractor may deduct. Applies to independent contractors, not employees: no payroll withholding or W-2 effect (search-result text read, full sections not printed)
